title.es: Mensajes de voz y avisos de estación

es: Extraer la idea general, las cifras, el propósito y el cambio de plan de mensajes de voz y avisos de estación dichos a velocidad natural, e inferir lo que el hablante da a entender.

teaching.en: You have one new voicemail from Ana, who says the party has moved and asks you to call her back tonight.
teaching.es: Tienes un mensaje de voz nuevo de Ana, que dice que la fiesta se ha cambiado y te pide que la llames esta noche.
teaching.explanationEs: Voicemail es el mensaje que alguien deja cuando no contestas; call back es devolver la llamada.
segments: You have one new voicemail from Ana, who says the party
has moved and asks you to call her back tonight.
teaching.audioText: You have one new voicemail from Ana, who says the party has moved and asks you to call her back tonight.

teaching.en: Attention, please: this announcement concerns the eight o'clock service, which is running twenty minutes behind schedule.
teaching.es: Atención, por favor: este aviso se refiere al servicio de las ocho, que lleva veinte minutos de retraso.
teaching.explanationEs: Los avisos empiezan con una fórmula fija (attention, please) y van al grano.
segments: Attention, please: this announcement concerns the eight o'clock
service, which is running twenty minutes behind schedule.
teaching.audioText: Attention, please: this announcement concerns the eight o'clock service, which is running twenty minutes behind schedule.

teaching.en: Owing to severe disruption on the line, the quarter past six train to Leeds is delayed by twenty minutes.
teaching.es: Debido a graves trastornos en la línea, el tren de las seis y cuarto a Leeds se retrasa veinte minutos.
teaching.explanationEs: Owing to introduce la causa; delayed by + cantidad indica cuánto se retrasa.
segments: Owing to severe disruption on the line, the quarter past
six train to Leeds is delayed by twenty minutes.
teaching.audioText: Owing to severe disruption on the line, the quarter past six train to Leeds is delayed by twenty minutes.

teaching.en: Passengers for London should use platform four instead of platform two, because the usual track is closed for repairs.
teaching.es: Los pasajeros a Londres deben usar el andén cuatro en lugar del dos, porque la vía habitual está cerrada por obras.
teaching.explanationEs: Instead of señala el cambio: primero lo nuevo, después lo antiguo.
segments: Passengers for London should use platform four instead of platform
two, because the usual track is closed for repairs.
teaching.audioText: Passengers for London should use platform four instead of platform two, because the usual track is closed for repairs.

teaching.en: Your flight has been cancelled, so please go to the desk to reschedule, or ask for a full refund if you prefer.
teaching.es: Su vuelo ha sido cancelado, así que acuda al mostrador para cambiarlo o pida un reembolso completo si lo prefiere.
teaching.explanationEs: Cancelled y reschedule avisan de un cambio de plan; el aviso suele ofrecer dos salidas.
segments: Your flight has been cancelled, so please go to the desk
to reschedule, or ask for a full refund if you prefer.
teaching.audioText: Your flight has been cancelled, so please go to the desk to reschedule, or ask for a full refund if you prefer.

teaching.en: I'm just giving you a heads-up: I can't meet at six, so could we make it seven instead?
teaching.es: Solo te aviso con antelación: no puedo quedar a las seis, así que ¿podríamos dejarlo en las siete?
teaching.explanationEs: Heads-up es un aviso previo informal; not… instead marca lo que se cancela y lo que lo sustituye.
segments: I'm just giving you a heads-up: I can't meet

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje de voz y elige por qué llama Ana.

choices.text: To announce a change and ask for a quick reply.
To invite Sara to a party for the first time.
To ask Sara to book another hall.

feedback.es: Ana avisa del cambio de día y pide una respuesta rápida: no es una invitación nueva ni una petición de sala.

hint.es: Fíjate en lo que Ana pide al final, no solo en lo que cuenta.

origin.audio: Hi Sara, it's Ana. I'm just giving you a heads-up: the party has been moved to Saturday, because the hall is booked on Friday. Everyone else has said yes, so please tell me by tonight if Saturday is a problem for you. Thanks!

prompt.es: Escucha el mismo mensaje y elige hasta cuándo debe responder Sara.

choices.text: By Friday.
By tonight.
By Saturday morning.

feedback.es: El plazo aparece tras «please tell me»: esta noche. El viernes y el sábado son fechas de la sala y la fiesta.

hint.es: Busca el plazo justo después de «please tell me».

origin.audio: Hi Sara, it's Ana. I'm just giving you a heads-up: the party has been moved to Saturday, because the hall is booked on Friday. Everyone else has said yes, so please tell me by tonight if Saturday is a problem for you. Thanks!

prompt.es: Completa el aviso: «Los pasajeros a Londres deben ir ahora al andén cuatro.»

feedback.es: Platform es el andén: en las estaciones se dice platform four, con el número después.

hint.es: Es el lugar de la estación donde se sube al tren.

origin.text: Passengers for London should now go to ___ four, because the usual track is closed for repairs. We apologise for the change.

prompt.es: Escucha el aviso y elige qué pueden hacer los pasajeros del tren suprimido.

choices.text: Wait at the station for the same train to leave later.
Take a replacement bus to Manchester.
Take a later train or ask for their money back.

feedback.es: El aviso ofrece dos opciones: subir al siguiente tren o reclamar el reembolso; no menciona autobuses sustitutivos.

origin.audio: Attention, please. Owing to a signal failure near Crewe, all services to Manchester are subject to severe disruption. The quarter past five train is delayed by approximately forty minutes, and the five forty-five has been cancelled. Passengers holding tickets for the cancelled service may board the next train or claim a full refund at the information desk. We apologise for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

prompt.es: Escucha el aviso otra vez y elige cuánto se retrasa el tren de las cinco y cuarto.

choices.text: About forty minutes.
About fourteen minutes.
About four minutes.

feedback.es: Forty y fourteen se confunden: forty lleva el acento al principio y fourteen al final; el aviso dice forty.

origin.audio: Attention, please. Owing to a signal failure near Crewe, all services to Manchester are subject to severe disruption. The quarter past five train is delayed by approximately forty minutes, and the five forty-five has been cancelled. Passengers holding tickets for the cancelled service may board the next train or claim a full refund at the information desk. We apologise for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada expresión de los avisos con su significado.

feedback.es: Son fórmulas fijas de avisos y mensajes: aprenderlas enteras ayuda a reconocerlas a velocidad natural.

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje de Carlos y elige qué pretende con él.

choices.text: To cancel the dinner and apologise to Tom for calling so late.
To offer Tom a choice between a late start and another day.
To ask Tom to collect him from the bus stop later.

feedback.es: Carlos propone empezar sin él o quedar mañana; no cancela y no pide que lo recojan.

origin.audio: Hi Tom, it's Carlos. Sorry to call so late. I know we agreed to meet at six, but my bus has been delayed and I won't get there before half past seven. Could you start dinner without me? Actually, if you would rather wait, we could meet tomorrow instead; I'm free after four. I'd hate to cancel the whole thing, because I've been looking forward to this all week. Anyway, call me back when you get this, and don't worry about the bus; I'll manage.

prompt.es: Escucha otra vez y elige qué deja entrever Carlos sobre el plan.

choices.text: That he has already lost interest in the dinner.
That he blames Tom for not warning him earlier.
That he would much rather keep the plan than cancel.

feedback.es: «I'd hate to cancel the whole thing» y «looking forward to this all week» dejan claro que prefiere mantener el plan.

origin.audio: Hi Tom, it's Carlos. Sorry to call so late. I know we agreed to meet at six, but my bus has been delayed and I won't get there before half past seven. Could you start dinner without me? Actually, if you would rather wait, we could meet tomorrow instead; I'm free after four. I'd hate to cancel the whole thing, because I've been looking forward to this all week. Anyway, call me back when you get this, and don't worry about the bus; I'll manage.

prompt.es: Escucha el aviso del aeropuerto y elige qué condición exige el hotel gratuito.

choices.text: Registering before eleven.
Choosing a refund instead of a new flight.
Booking the nine o'clock flight in advance.

feedback.es: El hotel se cubre solo «for passengers who register before eleven»: la condición es registrarse a tiempo.

origin.audio: Good evening. Flight two four one to Madrid has been cancelled owing to bad weather. Passengers should go to the desk to change their booking, or ask for a full refund if they prefer not to travel. The next flight leaves tomorrow at nine, and the airline will cover a hotel tonight, but only for passengers who register before eleven.

prompt.es: Completa la petición: «¿Podríamos cambiar la reunión al jueves por la tarde?»

feedback.es: Reschedule + fecha nueva es el verbo preciso para cambiar una cita ya fijada; se usa con for.

origin.text: I'm afraid Tuesday no longer works for me. Would it be possible to ___ our meeting for Thursday afternoon instead?

prompt.es: Escucha a la clínica y elige qué debe hacer el paciente si ninguna fecha le conviene.

choices.text: Wait for a new letter with a third date.
Phone the clinic again to find another time.
Come on Monday at ten anyway.

feedback.es: La clínica pide que, si ninguna opción sirve, el paciente llame otra vez para buscar otro horario.

origin.audio: Hello, this is Dr Patel's clinic. Your appointment on Monday at ten has had to be moved because the doctor is attending a conference. We can offer you Tuesday at eleven or Thursday at half past two. If neither suits you, please call us back and we'll look for another time.

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje de Mia y elige qué da a entender sobre la entrada del oyente.

choices.text: It will cost fifty pounds, even with the student discount.
It has already been paid for by Leo, so nothing is needed.
It could go to Leo if there is no answer tonight.

feedback.es: «Otherwise, I'll offer yours to Leo» implica que la entrada pasará a Leo si no hay respuesta esta noche.

origin.audio: Hello, it's Mia. The tickets are fifty pounds each, but there's a student discount that brings them down to thirty-five. I need the money by Thursday, so if you want one, let me know tonight. Otherwise, I'll offer yours to Leo.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Por favor, devuélveme la llamada en cuanto puedas.»

answer.text: Please call me back as soon as you can

feedback.es: En call back el pronombre va en medio, y as soon as you can cierra la petición con cortesía.
